title: The first step up
description: Which meeting for 2–7 people to hold first, whom to invite, how to tell your current clients, who stays one to one, and the plan of the step in “My map”.

units.title: Through the client's eyes: telling your current clients

objectives.text: Choose one of three forms of a meeting for 2–7 people that suits your method
Draw up a list of 3–7 people and the criteria by which you choose them
Tell your clients about the step so that no one feels abandoned, and decide who stays one to one
Put together the plan of the step with a date and record it in “My map” on the ladder

checks.question: A meta-analysis of psychotherapy: with the same protocol, group and individual formats gave the same result. What follows from this?
options: It is time to move all clients into a group
In psychotherapy a group is no worse, but that does not mean it suits everyone — the choice remains
One-to-one work is no longer needed
The finding can be carried over to coaching without caveats
checks.explain: An equal result in psychotherapy does not mean everyone needs a group. Reviews say the group format is not for everyone, and in coaching the data disagree (u1, “What research says”).

checks.question: Whom is it better not to invite to a first small group?
options: A client with a similar request
A person from the waiting list
A client who shows the signs from the lesson on the edge of competence
A client's friend who asked about a group
checks.explain: A client with such signs needs a specialist, not a group. This is the third selection criterion (u2, “Three criteria”).

checks.question: How is it better to tell current clients about a first small group?
options: In one mailing to everyone at once
Each in their own conversation: what changes for them and what stays as it was
Say nothing until the group is full
Move everyone into the group from next week
checks.explain: A mailing sounds like “I am being handed over”. Their own conversation lets a client hear “I am being offered more” and learn whether their sessions stay (u3, “Each their own conversation”).

checks.question: The meeting you have in mind is not in the ladder's list of formats. How do you record the step in “My map”?
options: You cannot: only a format from the list can be chosen
Through “my own format” with the name of the meeting, a date and a sign
Choose any similar format from the list
Write the meeting in the “Where I am now” field
checks.explain: “My map” has “my own format”: you write in the name of a meeting that is not in the list, with a date and a sign next to it (u4, the section on “My map”).
